name: ONNXMultilabelSegmentation
description: ONNX Runtime eye-segmentation adapter validating a local ONNX model, preparing infrared image tensors, running CPU inference and returning resized multilabel segmentation maps; a factory can retrieve model files from Hugging Face.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: huggingface-hub for the optional download factory
metadata.overlap: A separately callable IRIS algorithm or subsystem. Compose through the package's IRImage/GeometryPolygons/IrisTemplate contracts; types, callbacks and mathematical helpers are shared dependencies. This is biometric processing, not a complete authorized identity service.
metadata.deployment_warning: The Hugging Face helper does not pin a revision in the source call. Pin and verify the external model artifact for reproducible deployment.
